setlist.title: Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Truckin'** (1 review): Bobby flubs a lyric around the seven-minute mark and the crowd audibly reacts [10]
- **Deep Elem Blues** (1 review): Reviewer enjoys hearing this played with electric instruments [9]
- **It Hurts Me Too** (1 review): Reviewer finds this version strong, though the recording cuts off at its end [6]
- **Good Lovin'** (1 review): Pigpen's spoken rap in this song is a highlight [9]
- **Me & Bobby McGee** (1 review): Named among the reviewer's favorites of the set [7]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 other source): Toward its end, the band seems to be heading into Eyes Of The World [1]
- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (1 review): It closes the sequence of Saint Stephen into Not Fade Away into Goin' Down the Road [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **Turn On Your Lovelight Tease**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **Uncle John's Band Tease**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]

## The recordings

- **gd70-12-27.sbd.miller.23530.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 145 min; rated 4.57/5 by 14 [1]. Said about its sound: Soundboard sounds good but not outstanding; Crisp, raw sound with mild buzz and hiss; vocals are loud and clear; Reviewer calls the transfer and sound excellent [5][6][11]
- **gd70-12-27.sbd.barbella.6016.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 145 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: Every band member is audible, with only a very mild hiss; Every band member can be heard clearly in the recording [3][7]

## Around the show

- Opening stage remarks told the crowd to wander and dance, since nothing surprising would happen [10]
- Part of a run at Legion Stadium in El Monte, with shows also on December 26 and 28 [12]
- Sound quality is on par with much of the other 1970 recordings [3]
- A transitional period; more polished than the looser, more spontaneous summer 1970 shows, with American Beauty material settling in [11]
- Few soundboards from late 1970 are in circulation, which makes this one worth getting [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-12-27.sbd.miller.23530.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Reviewer points to Charlie Miller's circulating soundboard collection as the source for this show; Uploader cleaned up cuts, fixed errors, removed several pops and re-tracked the discs [1][12]
- **gd70-12-27.sbd.barbella.6016.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Steve Barbella and Seth Kaplan; source: Soundboard [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Legion Stadium - December 28, 1970](https://www.dead.net/show/december-28-1970) [16]
